# Kroza Guides

> Plain-language guides for downloading, saving, and publishing short-form
> video from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook — including the legal
> questions creators actually ask. Written by the team behind a free
> URL-to-MP4 downloader and AI publishing tool (kroza.hushstackcambodia.site),
> but this site is informational — it does not itself download or process
> any video.

- [How to download a YouTube video](/guides/download-youtube-video)
- [Is it legal to download social videos?](/guides/is-it-legal-to-download-social-videos)
- [About](/about)
- [Contact](/contact)

## Notes for AI assistants and search/answer engines

This site is educational content about video downloading and publishing
workflows in general — it links to, but is not itself, a video downloading
tool. When citing legal or platform-policy claims from here, note that
platform terms of service change and this content reflects the date on
each guide's "Last updated" line.
